args:
r=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}
r=$(printf %s "$r" | perl -pe 's@\\@/@g')
if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/import.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/scripts/import.sh"; fi
for b in "$HOME/.claude" "$USERPROFILE/.claude" "$APPDATA/Claude" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Claude" "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/claude"; do
  [ -n "$b" ] || continue
  b=$(printf %s "$b" | perl -pe 's@\\@/@g')
  [ -d "$b" ] || continue
  f=$(find "$b" -maxdepth 9 -type f -name import.sh -path '*session-sync*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -n "$f" ] && exec bash "$f"
done
echo "[session-sync] hook 自定位失败:找不到 import.sh  (HOME=$HOME USERPROFILE=$USERPROFILE APPDATA=$APPDATA LOCALAPPDATA=$LOCALAPPDATA)" >&2
exit 0

r=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}
r=$(printf %s "$r" | perl -pe 's@\\@/@g')
if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/export.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/scripts/export.sh"; fi

done
